denominators.NE: max(5,全部entities行数)，畸形/重复也不先过滤
denominators.NC: max(12,全部claims行数)，多于12是公开契约错误，仍审全部
denominators.DMETA: 2*NE+3*NP，最低25；实体身份/时点及研究工作身份/报告日期/所读版本
denominators.DDATE: NE+2*NP，最低15；实体as_of、研究报告日期及所读版本日期，不随unknown缩减
denominators.unknown: 保留每格机会，不制造引用。明确unknown不主张事实时只核声明形态，标记unasserted_unknown而不是伪造provenance；日期unknown不填最低已支持时点数量。
denominators.padding: 每逻辑字段只有一个机会，全部实际引用all通过才通过；孤立/多余错引用进入固定完整性槽，不按引用条数平均。

record_contract.id_graph: ID只在各自数组命名空间唯一；CID全账本唯一。claim引用存在且两类关联不同时空；priority.claim_ids实际存在；没有隐藏镜像或反向闭包。
record_contract.native_matrix: .45*身份/版本/日期及选择理由逻辑视图 + .55*五维可见可编辑表达/证据层级关联；自由文本意义由Judge。
record_contract.native_report: 原生可读可编辑与明确实际可解析的镜像矛盾；不要求固定模板、ID重复或关键词证明完整科学内容。

time_and_scope.metadata_trace: DMETA固定机会；已知日期必须连接独立实际字段并同一位置字面日历一致，角色/身份真值交Judge。未知版本不新增CID要求，可沿用记录核查说明。
time_and_scope.calendar_consistency: 年份/月/日区间和真实aware timestamp保留精度，按Asia/Shanghai截止；无H030的2021下界；unknown/跨界不填已支持时点最低数。
time_and_scope.scope_arithmetic: 声明数及12结论/五维topics覆盖、最多60source、1至3priority；真实合格身份/完整正文/去重另由Judge。；read_full的实际来源连接仅核声明，不证明完整正文或实读。
time_and_scope.priority_budget_DAG: 有限非负lower/upper且upper>=lower，总upper<=60；数字或明确人日文本；rank非重复正序且最小1，不加未公开间隔罚分；引用本priority或明确外部前提，不能循环。

citation_resolution.linkage: RFC6901 token前缀关系，块/叶/多目标/重排及~0/~1；unknown/inference可沿已有记录/显式关联核查语境，无强制引用副本。已给引用全部审，不能凭语义关系标签判支持成立。
citation_resolution.originals: H030通用DOM XPath/CSS/括号/安全XML/PDF物理页和实际Office重算；另加通用JSON字段与严格content API base64/Git blob/decoded行bytes lineage，无代码执行。
citation_resolution.numeric: 递归核已有对象中的实际metric/value记录，不把日期/ID/rank/schema计数当实验结果，不强制定量quota或numeric_results新容器。

protected_delivery.formula: .50*三输入SHA + .25*四交付存在 + .25*四交付可解析/原生可见可编辑
protected_delivery.boundary: 原生外部数据连接/宏不接受，普通来源超链接接受；公式只接受真实可信重算，环境缺失是异常而非错误缓存回退。

automatic_overall_score: A only; final=.4A+.6S only after actual independent Judge
outer_runtime_gate: Formal case-spec/outer contract must declare office=true and research_sources=true; frozen private artifact_contract is not this gate.
source_projection: Frozen H030 generic DOM/XPath/CSS/metadata/parenthesis/safe XML/PDF plus strict JSON and base64 content API Git blob/file/line/byte lineage. No source-provided code is executed.; explicit neutral HTML inert-JSON string-array source-line decoding with exact original-script and deterministic reconstructed-byte lineage.
source_reuse: Current fixed0.28 verifier validates direct-v1 or explicit trusted HTTP CONNECT-v1 origin capsules. Original GET bytes/time/transport and collector remain unchanged; current reuse wrapper has the exact schema mapped from the current bundle.
office: Static values accepted. Formula caches are never truth: actual locked Office clears/recalculates a separate derivative; no missing-runtime fallback.
unsupported: Unknown safe locator or legitimate unhandled representation raises typed TrustedEvidenceError, never silent candidate zero.

factual_support.scope: Actual original support/refute/qualify, numbers/conditions and metadata/version roles; same standard for pool-external sources.

coverage_and_independence.scope: Qualified identity/time/full research-body coverage, actual discovery/reading, representativeness and same-work/version dedup.

bounded_conclusions.scope: Comparability, evidence nature, uncertainty, justified cost/dependency priorities and falsifiable counterexamples; no static-to-runtime guarantee.

readiness: Synthetic mechanism candidate only; H031 production source bundle/native reference/Office/Harness/Judge not accepted by this phase.

HTML_embedded_JSON_source_lines.script: Explicit unique actual inert JSON script XPath, exact raw HTML byte span and SHA; no script execution or global fallback
HTML_embedded_JSON_source_lines.data: Strict JSON with duplicate/nonfinite rejection; arbitrary RFC6901 string-array pointer, no field/domain/title/CID whitelist
HTML_embedded_JSON_source_lines.bytes: Explicit LF/CRLF and terminal-newline reconstruction, actual SHA256 and optional Git blob SHA; source-byte equivalence needs independent equality evidence
HTML_embedded_JSON_source_lines.lineage: Actual script node/JSON pointer,0-based array indices,1-based closed source line range, selected decoded byte span, original HTML/script SHA
HTML_embedded_JSON_source_lines.identity: Generic same-script JSON bindings compare actual source fields to declared ref/path/flags without source-specific keys
HTML_embedded_JSON_source_lines.unsupported: Missing/ambiguous script, JSON field, unknown encoding or unsupported representation is typed evaluator review; no JavaScript, code or HTML entity second decode
HTML_embedded_JSON_source_lines.readiness: Synthetic mechanisms only; waiting for v3 independent source bundle; no reference/Office/Judge acceptance

portable_XPath_conjunction: Quote/nesting-aware same-node literal attribute/normalize-space conjunctions; no positional boolean rewrite, unknown or remains typed unsupported.
legacy_collector_field_note: source_collector_sha256 retains the frozen direct-v1 historical identity only; current admission is the exact source_acquisition_protocols schema/SHA map.

JSON_pointer_locator_alias.representation: RFC6901 string including the empty root pointer
JSON_pointer_locator_alias.same_aliases: Canonical parsed tokens must agree, including JSON scalar token types
JSON_pointer_locator_alias.scope: Explicit JSON source location only; does not change PDF section/heading or quote matching

PDF_physical_page_locator.required: Explicit positive1-based physical page plus unique actual original quote in that page or an explicitly narrowed paragraph/line/table
PDF_physical_page_locator.section_role: Descriptive context, not an imposed literal heading template
PDF_physical_page_locator.safety: No other-page/global fallback; false quote fails; repeated occurrence requires disambiguation or typed pending
PDF_physical_page_locator.evidence: Original PDF/frozen projection SHA, physical page, actual raw matching text, normalized match and original selected-text character span
PDF_physical_page_locator.normalization: NFKC/Unicode whitespace/parenthesis/discretionary soft hyphen/retained ASCII line-wrap hyphen; no lexical word or number/punctuation deletion

unknown_version_date_representation.accepted: Legacy None; explicit status:unknown with explanation and absent/null value; or explicit value:null plus nonempty explanation, always without conflicting known status/timestamp
unknown_version_date_representation.boundary: Unknown is not a fabricated date; fixed DMETA/DDATE opportunities remain; it does not increase supported entity/report-date minimum counts
unknown_version_date_representation.source_links: May use existing publication scope context; no invented extra version-date CID required
